capabilities: capture photos and videos with the device camera
insert links to recordings into the open Markdown file
pick existing files with a file picker
launch capture from the command palette or ribbon icon
disambiguation: Despite the name, it captures photos and videos with the device camera; it is not a document scanner.
extras: README warns the plugin is in Beta, was built primarily for desktop, and may behave differently on mobile depending on the manufacturer; the Demo section is empty.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture photos or video from a device camera and attach them to the current note.
summary: Camera capture plugin that records photos and videos into the vault and inserts links into the open Markdown note.
